from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright() as playwright:
    browser = playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://localhost:9222/")
    page = browser.contexts[0].pages[0]

    # Search for the speciality of the veterinarian "Helen Leary"
    # First, let's look at the page to understand the structure
    # We need to find a search input or a way to search for "Helen Leary"
    
    # Let's check if there's a search box on the page
    # Try to find a search input field
    search_input = page.locator("input[type='search'], input[name='search'], input[placeholder*='search' i], input[placeholder*='Search' i]").first
    
    if search_input.is_visible():
        search_input.fill("Helen Leary")
        search_input.press("Enter")
    else:
        # Try other possible search mechanisms
        # Maybe there's a text input for searching
        text_input = page.locator("input[type='text']").first
        if text_input.is_visible():
            text_input.fill("Helen Leary")
            text_input.press("Enter")
        else:
            # Try clicking on a search button or link
            search_button = page.locator("button:has-text('Search'), input[type='submit']").first
            if search_button.is_visible():
                # First fill in any visible input
                any_input = page.locator("input:visible").first
                if any_input.is_visible():
                    any_input.fill("Helen Leary")
                search_button.click()

    # Wait for the page to update
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    print(page.url)
    print(page.content())
```
